chapter: A Splash of Color on the Plate!
act_title: A Splash of Color on the Plate!

quests.title: A Splash of Color on the Plate!

dialogue.t: Looks like our colorist Ashas are very much satisfied now.
Another challenge completed for our wondrous Ashas!
Is this Asha here inspired to start another artwork already?

dialogue.sit: Well, you know how inspiration can come and go in the blink of an eye...
So you have to strike while the iron is still hot.

dialogue.t: Ah, look at all the treasure it's left behind... {NICKNAME} and Paimon, the two of you should have it! For all the hard work you've put in!
Maybe the next time we come by, we'll be able to see the colorist Asha's masterpiece.
Just imagine what kind of work it would be! Especially when even the regular Ashas are already capable of coming up with such beautiful colors.
Paimon can't wait to see what the colorist Ashas will create! Maybe they'll come up with something... beyond what words can describe.
Maybe the colors of Phlogiston, the moon, or the depths of the starry sky?
Yeah, that's exactly how it should be! If we come across a creature in some kind of trouble during our adventures, we should do everything we can to help it...
Mm-hmm! Who knows? Maybe one day we'll receive some unexpected rewards!

dialogue.sit: And it feels very fulfilling as well.

dialogue.t: Ah, but... We shouldn't do it just because of some expected reward. That'd be beside the point.
Even if there's nothing in it for us, helping friends in need and seeing their smiles return as things turn for the better...

quests.description: You have finished collecting the free-roaming color paints. The colorist Ashas are very pleased with the haul…
